Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 3. Warranty Bidder / OEM has to give an undertaking that after expiry of warranty period, it will provide Comprehensive Maintenance Service for next 5 years for the offered products at the rate not more than 5 % of contract price per annum. Buyer reserves the right to enter into a CMC agreement with the Successful Bidder / OEM after expiry of the Warranty period at above mentioned rate and the payment for the CMC charges would be made Quarterly after rendering of the CMC Services of the relevant CMC period. Performance Security of the successful bidder shall be forfeited if it fails to accept the CMC contract when called upon by the buyer. CMC would include cost of All required spare parts (Upload the undertaking). The original Performance Security of contract will be returned only after submission and verification of AMC Performance Security for 10% of total CMC value valid up to CMC period plus 2 months (if there is no other claim). 4. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 5 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during

the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 6. 6. Equipment should be quoted as per the specification attached at ATC. 7. Technical specifications a) It should be Reusable underwater bubble CPAP system. b) It should have CPAP range 1–10 cm H₂O in 1 cm increments. c) It should have In-built air-oxygen blender with FiO₂ 21–100% (±2%). d) It should have flow 0–15 L/min (±0.5 L/min). e) It should have Heated-wire servo-controlled humidifier with temperature display near patient. f) Reusable humidifier chamber should be provided. g) Reusable heated-wire silicone infant circuit should be provided. h) It should be Compatible with nasal and nasopharyngeal prongs. i) It should have a pressure release valve at 15–17 cm H₂O. j) The weight should be less than 8 kg k) It should have operating noise not more than 65 dB. l) It should be a portable unit mounted on lockable castors. m) Its electrical supply should be compatible with 220-240 V AC, 50 Hz +/-10%. n) It must have power consumption of less than 140 W. o) It should have earth-leakage and over-voltage protection. p) It must have quality management standards compliant with ISO 13485 and ISO 9001. q) It must confirm with electrical safety standards of IEC 60601-1-2:2007, IEC 60601-1-8:2006 and IE C 60601-1-1-SER Ed. 1.0:2011, or equivalent applicable BIS standards 8. Servo-Controlled Humidifier a) It should be capable of working with CPAP. b) It should be capable of supplying fully saturated oxygen gas at 37°C c) It must have working temperature range of 31–40°C. d) It should have temperature control of ±2°C. e) It must have auto and servo-controlled modes for invasive and non-invasive ventilation. f) It should have default settings of 37°C (invasive), 34°C (non-invasive). g) It should be capable of ambient humidity compensation. h) It should be compatible with both reusable and disposable chambers and circuits. i) It must have water level indicator in the chamber. j) It must have minimum warm-up time of <30 minutes. k) It must display: modes of operation, respective chamber and Y-piece temperatures, pictori al visual alarm. 9. Alarms

a) It must have high-priority alarms: temperature too high, water level too high and humidifier danger ously inclined. b) It must have medium-priority alarms: humidifier chamber not inserted, tube not connected or defe ctive, and invalid chamber. c) It must have additional alarms: low humidity/low temperature and low water level. d) The alarm indication to include audible and pictorial visual alerts according to priority. e) Alarm loudness to be at least 65 dB measured within 1 meter. 10. Terms and Conditions · Prices so quoted should be frozen for 10 years including warranty · Warranty period: 5 years. · CAMC for 5 years after warranty. CAMC should cover preventive maintenance, service visits, labour an d covered replacement parts/spares, excluding routine consumables. Items covered under CAMC and warranty should be clearly enlisted, along with items not covered under CAMC and warranty. · Original literature, and not the photocopy, should be supplied with the quotation. · Company should certify that the model quoted is the latest and not obsolete, and spares are available for minimum 10 years including warranty. Frozen rate should not be more than the price of the quoted rate on the date of purchase. · Rate list of all the accessories/consumables should be provided separately. These rates should be froz en for next 10 years. · Provision for providing 1 loaner unit if time taken for repair is more than 14 days. · Physical demonstration of the quoted model will be taken to verify the specifications. · The supplier/company should install and commission the equipment, perform safety and operation che cks before handover, and provide hands-on training to designated users. · The equipment should maintain minimum 98% uptime during warranty/CAMC period. Equipment down time of 2 weeks or more should be managed as per the loaner provision above. · Authorized service personnel should visit the consignee site as per CAMC clause. · The calibration procedure should be simple and user-friendly. The supplier should provide the list of eq uipment/procedures required for local calibration and routine maintenance. · The bidder should submit all applicable certifications, licences and test reports with the technical bid a nd/or at the time of supply, as required. Certificates should correspond to the quoted model. · The above specifications are generic and performance-based and are not tailor-made for any particula r make or model. Multiple reputed manufacturers meeting the stated requirements should be eligible f or consideration. 11. Consumables and Accessories The following shall be supplied with each unit at the time of supply: · 30 neonatal short nasal/nasopharyngeal prongs in assorted preterm and term sizes. · 5 neonatal nasal masks in appropriate sizes. · One air hose and one oxygen hose, each at least 3 metres long, compatible with the hospital gas outle ts. · 2 reusable heated-wire silicone infant breathing circuits.
· 2 reusable humidifier chambers. · 2 reusable water chambers. · All connectors, mounting accessories, power cables and other items required to make the system com plete and functional. .
